budget.rate: Human-confirmed conservative CU/hour; recorded estimate, not provider metering
budget.interruption: charge unknown interval to restart; latch STOP
budget.coverage: runner bundle/runtime validation, rankgauss and fits; upload/pip/operator idle require separate Human billing reconciliation
budget.stage_estimate: positive planned-hours-per-fit also bounds each validation/rankgauss stage

checkpoints.policy: local serialize/fsync/hash -> durable exclusive copy/fsync/reverify -> atomic pointer
checkpoints.resume: completed fits only; partial attempts preserved, no automatic orphan promotion

acceptance.rule: CI lower bound > 0 AND Holm p < .05
acceptance.provenance: P3/P2 frozen contracts govern existing results; P4 never supersedes

freeze_required: Human/Claude approval and frozen recipe/config/budget plan before formal execution
